content.short: MintMatrix offers digital asset management infrastructure for a frictionless financial world.
content.description: MintMatrix is committed to developing fair, fast, and frictionless financial infrastructure. With a proven track record in controlling complex dynamical systems, writing aerospace flight and simulation software, and experimental flight testing, we bring our strong foundational knowledge of mission critical systems to the financial world by enabling users to digitize assets, transact with clients, and organize capital in the new era of digital fusion. MintMatrix is committed to developing fair, fast, and frictionless financial infrastructure.
